description.value: Railtown Cafe has been serving scratch-made healthy comfort food in Vancouver since 2012, founded by chefs Dan Olson and Tyler Day who also operate the award-winning Railtown Catering out of the same Railway Street facility. The menu spans gourmet sandwiches, house-made soups, a build-your-own salad bar, artisan breads, pastries, and locally roasted coffee, with vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options throughout. The Howe Street location is one of three downtown outposts, making it accessible along several urban cycling corridors.
